answer: When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 4 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. The grove record keeps the spread, mesa schedules the escalation, and reef publishes the outcome. A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors because a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. A 458 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
